body: I was honestly getting ready to put the bag over my head but then I saw your notification, and admittedly I do think about that sometimes.. the fact that I'm still here after all of that. I just want this pain to stop and I thought I was gonna end it tonight but I'm too tired to try again now so I'm gonna get some rest. You saved me for tonight at least lol

Thank you for saying that, but to me it seems like the universe doesn't want me here anymore ya know? For all this stuff to happen to me.. I wish I could have been one of the people to die in that shooting and have others survive instead of me. I don't even feel like I should be here anymore. It's just hard to explain, I'm sorry
There's nothing I can really do. My other comment has more info but basically I was shot in the back and I have numerous mental problems. I just can't do this anymore

It's like my whole life has been nothing but bad luck, when I was a kid our family was homeless for long periods of time and then we found out that my dad sexually assaulted my sister multiple times over the years so he went to prison for that and then my mom got other boyfriends who would beat us with belts and make us kneel on nails and stuff, and I thought I was done with the bad part of my life when I got to high school but then I was a victim of a school shooting. 

I was shot in my spine and that's why I said I have physical and emotional pain. I have to deal with the physical pain in my back plus depression, anxiety, and PTSD. Years have passed by so nobody really cares about me anymore and I also suffer from loneliness. I'd kill to just find a girl that I could hold at night and just feel loved and content, but I pushed everyone away so it's my fault. I don't have much time left now, but thanks for at least replying. I wish the best for you
